captions.text: A demo video says the robot works.
Someone asks whether it is real, or sped up, or remote controlled.
Code, a circuit board, or a launch page: the question is the same. What is true?
Product Actualizer keeps one model of what is true.
Every claim carries a grade, and a source anyone can re-open.
Seventeen lenses read that model: brand and motion, electronics and firmware, three-dimensional renders.
A hardware release cannot pass on a build, a schematic, or a render.
The claim has to be exercised on the real unit.
In the hardware example, the gate said no. Most physical claims had never run on the unit.
A page cannot cite what was only reported.
And when the model changes, whatever cites it goes stale.
Agents and tools do the work. Only the owner accepts it.
Product Actualizer. Finish the product. Show the evidence.
